title: Onboard orion-lite-8b v1.0 — perf profiles, metadata and changelog automation
author: Lena Thompson
release_notes: Add orion-lite-8b v1.0 to model registry with curated metadata, multiple performance profiles (latency/cost/throughput) and automated changelog generation for release notes.
description: Motivation: We are onboarding orion-lite-8b v1.0 to the public catalog to provide a cost-efficient option for low-latency inference. This PR includes (1) model metadata (schema-compatible with registry), (2) curated performance profiles generated from benchmark-lab runs, (3) an automated changelog entry produced by the changelog automation pipeline, and (4) small validation and CI fixes to make metadata linting deterministic. What changed — high level: added model metadata JSON, performance_profiles/benchmarks for common sequence lengths and batch sizes, automated changelog generation hook, unit tests for metadata schema, and a small fix to the perf profile name normalization logic. Checklist: - [x] Add canonical metadata (id, model_family, sizes, tokenizer, supported_ops) - [x] Add performance profiles (latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, memory footprints) - [x] Add changelog template and automation trigger - [x] Add metadata schema unit tests and CI job - [x] Validate changelog generation output matches release_notes format Commits: 4 commits — "add orion-lite metadata and weights manifest", "generate perf profiles from benchmark-lab run 2026-02-10", "changelog automation: add template + job", "fix: normalize perf profile names and deterministic ordering". Files changed (high level): - models/orion-lite-8b/metadata.json - models/orion-lite-8b/perf_profiles/seq256_batch1.json - models/orion-lite-8b/perf_profiles/seq1024_batch4.json - tools/changelog-generator/templates/model-onboard.md.tpl - tools/changelog-generator/jobs/onboard-changelog.yml - tests/registry/test_metadata_schema.py - scripts/perf/normalize_profiles.py - CI: .github/workflows/registry-ci.yml (add metadata lint step) Review summary: Rahul asked for clearer guidance on which profile should be the default for the hosted catalog — answered that seq256_batch1 is the default for low-latency tier and added an explicit "default_profile" field to metadata.json. Sofia requested stricter validation for tokenizer names — added a unit test and a small mapping table to normalize common synonyms. Diego caught a flaky test in the changelog job — fixed by making timestamp generation deterministic in tests. CI: initial run failed on linting due to ordering in perf profiles; reordered and added deterministic sort in normalize_profiles.py, re-ran and CI passed. Merge: squash-merge to main after approvals from Rahul and Sofia. Notes for release: This PR will create a changelog entry under releases/orion-lite-8b v1.0 and surface a recommended performance profile for Hosted/ Dedicated/Private tiers. No breaking changes expected. QA notes: Evals team ran a small prompt-suite to sanity-check generation quality vs aurora-lite baseline; quality delta within expected bounds. Follow-ups: - Add a lightweight example in redwood-quickstarts demonstrating cost/latency tradeoffs for orion-lite-8b - Monitor early usage for model routing fallbacks (ENG-3421).
